name: Volunteer Page - Fall 2026 Roles
description: The volunteer page's roles section with the Fall 2026 volunteer sheet published: 'Volunteer roles open this fall', then the city roles first (SF / Bay Area, New York City, NYC × AI Events, Boston / Cambridge, London) and the team roles after them, with the four roles editors added earlier kept at the end. Every role signs up through the volunteer interest form; no contact names or volunteer details are published. At Mobile the grid is one column and roles without a photo show no empty placeholder band, so each card starts with its title. The hover only scrolls the section into view.
